process: the monarchy is hereditary; high commissioner appointed by the monarch; premier indirectly elected by Parliament for a 4-year term
results: 2025: Jens-Frederik NIELSEN (D) elected premier; 2021: Mute B. EGEDE elected premier; Parliament vote - Mute B. EGEDE (Inuit Ataqatigiit) unanimous; 2014: Kim KIELSEN elected premier; Parliament vote - Kim KIELSEN (S) 27.2%, Sara OLSVIG (IA) 25.5%, Randi Vestergaard EVALDSEN (D) 19.5%, other 27.8%
governmentType: parliamentary democracy (Parliament of Greenland or Inatsisartut)
cabinet: Self-rule Government (Naalakkersuisut) elected by the Parliament (Inatsisartut)
